observations.kind: existing central finding/symptom family, no new count
observations.first_contract: For a CityGate hinge on the positive tangent side the gate source positions hinge = centre + tangent * width/2, while server spawn_door computes doorway = hinge + tangent * width/2 regardless of side; the server diagnostic computes the leaf hinge as closed position minus local half-width. Normal building door compilation puts hinge on the negative tangent side.
observations.condition: This is the same source relation already assessed in ASSESSMENT-GATE-HANDEDNESS-95E; interpretation assumes the recorded gate-side geometry, axis mapping and finite source values. No actual generated scene, actor, collision, motor behavior, diagnostic execution or product incidence shown. The diagnostic is a related symptom, not an independently counted physics failure.
observations.direction: Reconcile the existing gate-handedness owner across gate/leaf/interaction/diagnostic, preserving intentional inward swing and independent facade identity; no proposed repair is implemented.

observations.kind: narrowed prior q2243 plus existing native error question
observations.first_contract: The server collects all architectural-to-scene door poses before beginning the door-spawn loop. Each spawn reads its unmutated leaf and native_rotation from one SceneDoorPose, checks the computed doorway centre, then queues leaf, joint and controller. The containing building observer spawns door and window openings before final collider insertion.
observations.condition: No independent mutation of the paired leaf was found in this server consumer. Earlier loop iterations can be queued before a later spawn_door error, and windows or collider creation may fail later, but a supported failing plan, native deferred-command outcome, cleanup or partial visible scene has not been established. Prior central Bevy observer source error analysis is separate native evidence and cannot be generalized to all other callers.

nonfindings.reason: Only source ordering is established; native observer error policy and supported failure reachability require separate evidence.

lenses.assessment: Building/opening typed IDs and paired pose flow from geometry to replicated SceneDoor; native entity-key exemptions and raw scalar motor values remain distinct consumers.

SceneBuildingId, OpeningAssemblyId, SceneDoorPose, scene-frame positions, directions and Entity all have distinct semantic owners; direct u64 access at logging or seed boundaries needs an explicit purpose.
Public SceneBuildingId admits any u64; per-slice validators reject zero/duplicates locally. Do not promote that to a global or cross-namespace guarantee.

Typed pose conversion is fallible before each native leaf, signed angle drives limits/motor and passage predicates operate in scene directions. Native physics and finite state contracts remain outside the read.
Leaf, hinge joint, motor, paired geometry, two exemption sets and scene/building identity have coupled state and lifecycle. Missing joint is silently skipped but reachability is unproved.
Building/property/opening IDs and Bevy entity keys represent different owners; visual seed reuse retains separate earlier producer/owner findings.

DoorController and SceneDoor receive related geometry from one creation path; paired pose is not independently mutated here. Exemptions and controller collision filter intentionally share a per-door policy but cleanup owner remains open.
Exact P16 and 95e role bytes match; whole dirty P16 snapshot and product do not. Preserve inward swing, symmetric intentional grab policy, motor limits and transient tactical authority.
PassageDecision explicitly encodes None/Retain/Revoke and motor selection derives from retained permission; no unsupported bool conversion remedy.
SceneBuildingId derives its ordinary traits and serde while Display forwards the numeric word at presentation; no necessary handmade trait removal established.

Position<Scene>, SpatialDirection<Scene>, angle/physics scalars and actor/door entities carry different frames and lifetimes. The handwritten native motor boundary does not alone warrant a new wrapper.
Door names and debug text are native diagnostics, not observed private string dispatch; digest expect text is a rule issue rather than a string protocol.

Physical motor, speed and release thresholds encode separate interaction/solver policies; gate bit tag is an existing distinct identity-domain question. No blanket replacement without consumer evidence.
